baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form-II active participle ٱلْمُدَبِّرَاتِ governs the indefinite accusative أَمْرًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The د ب ر image of examining an affair's end makes the action backward-looking from consequence to arrangement, while ء م ر supplies the affair or state being arranged.

activation_trace.role: Looking to an affair's outcome supplies consequence-aware planning and anchors the governing function.
The affair, condition, or general case supplies the open object whose course is ordered.

changed_reading.before: Plural agents handle an unspecified affair.
changed_reading.after: Plural agents order an affair by reasoning from its intended aftermath back into its present course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَمْرًا can be a binding command, and ٱلْمُدَبِّرَاتِ names active arrangers rather than the command's source.
baseline_models.mechanism: Outcome-aware tadbir converts an imperative into an executable sequence; the agents operationalize a command by arranging the consequences that fulfill it.

activation_trace.role: Management through attention to the end supplies the command-to-result conversion.
Binding request and obligation make the object an imperative to be carried into effect.

changed_reading.before: The agents merely manage a matter.
changed_reading.after: The agents translate a binding command into the ordered operations that realize it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A plural feminine active participle is paired with an أَمْر that can denote office, rule, or authority.
baseline_models.mechanism: The plurality distributes administrative work, while the authority branch of ء م ر raises the possibility of delegated governance rather than merely handling an impersonal task.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate management toward an outcome supplies the exercise of governance.
Office, rule, and the holder of authority supply the governmental domain being distributed.

changed_reading.after: Several actors exercise coordinated, potentially delegated authority over how an affair reaches its end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies removal carried through fully, rapid release, free movement, and advance; ٱلْمُدَبِّرَاتِ then reads as the terminal control stage that converts a moving process into fulfillment of أَمْرًا.

activation_trace.role: Outcome-aware management supplies the culminating control function of the sequence.
The binding command supplies the result toward which the preceding operations are directed.
Removal from a settled place supplies the pipeline's initiating displacement.
Comprehensive engulfing or carrying-through makes the initial operation exhaustive rather than partial.
Rapid pulling and removal supply the transition from extraction into released motion.
Running or swimming supplies sustained movement through a medium.
Advancing and outstripping supply arrival at the leading position before governance takes over.

structural_cues: 79:1-5 repeat feminine plural active participles, with cognate accusatives in 79:1-4 and أَمْرًا occupying the final accusative slot.
The فَ links 79:4 and 79:5 as successive culmination points rather than resetting the series.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered motion images and parallel grammar; I infer a functional pipeline whose phases feed the final tadbir. A live alternative is that the lines enumerate independent agents or acts rather than one process.

changed_reading.before: The agents operationalize a command in an unspecified way.
changed_reading.after: The agents are the control phase of a staged operation, turning exhaustive extraction, release, transit, and precedence into the command's governed result.

context_deltas.mechanism: A first severe disturbance is followed by another, the disputed return is described through restoration to an earlier condition and renewed recurrence, and one driving cry completes the transition. Tadbir therefore governs a sequenced reversal of state, not only ongoing maintenance.

activation_trace.role: Planning by the final consequence supplies the design that holds the reversal sequence together.
The last phase and passing aftermath foreground the terminal state reached by the process.
A command supplies the compact initiating authority behind the state change.
Severe disturbance supplies the first destabilizing event.
Following and tracking supply an explicit directional link from the first event to the next.
Coming immediately after another thing supplies the second stage in the paired disturbance.
Return to a thing or restoration to its place supplies the contested reversal.
Return to the beginning sharpens reversal as restoration to an earlier condition.
Renewed return after a prior occurrence supplies recurrence rather than simple continuation.
A forceful vocal drive supplies the efficient impulse that executes the transition.
Numerical oneness compresses execution into a single decisive impulse.

structural_cues: 79:6-7 encode two ordered events, while 79:10-12 repeat return language from the objectors' perspective.
79:13-14 answer the extended objection with one impulse followed by immediate presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disturbance, following, return, recurrence, and one driving cry; I infer that the focus line administers this downstream transition. The live alternative is that these are consequences of the arranged affair without specifying its internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Outcome-aware governance keeps an affair on course.
changed_reading.after: Outcome-aware governance scripts a two-beat destabilization and a one-impulse restoration to a radically changed state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh exceeds the limit, undertakes public administration, gathers and calls, and claims supreme lordship; the sequence's end turns him into a deterrent spanning latter and former. This contrasts visible mobilization with tadbir validated by command over aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Judging management by its outcome supplies the criterion that exposes failed rule.
Office, rule, and sovereignty make the focus line available for comparison with claimed authority.
Exceeding the limit in disobedience marks the rival rule as structurally unbounded.
Administrative striving over a people supplies the rival ruler's active governing effort.
Driving and gathering a group toward one aim supplies centralized mobilization.
Raised public calling supplies the audible display of command.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty supply the substance of the public claim.
Grandeur and domination make the claim one of overriding supremacy.
Punishment that deters others turns the ruler's outcome into a public counter-command.
Laterness supplies one temporal edge of the comprehensive consequence.
Beginning and precedence supply the other temporal edge, making the outcome span former and latter.

structural_cues: 79:22 repeats the focus root as أَدْبَرَ: Pharaoh turns his back and then strives, reversing the focus image of looking through to an affair's end.
79:22-25 forms a rapid chain from withdrawal through mobilization and proclamation to seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rival ruler's mobilization, supremacy claim, and terminal defeat; I infer a failed counter-administration measured by its end. The live alternative is that the narrative is a moral example without directly unpacking ٱلْمُدَبِّرَاتِ.

changed_reading.before: Plural agents exercise distributed authority over an affair.
changed_reading.after: True administration is distinguished from loud sovereign performance by command of the aftermath; rule that turns from its limit exposes itself as failed tadbir.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation becomes joined construction, structural support, completion, emergence of water and pasture, anchoring, and usable provision. The affair is thus administered as an integrated habitat whose successful end is stable benefit.

activation_trace.role: Attention to final consequences turns the material sequence into design for an inhabitable result.
Growth, abundance, and blessing identify productive flourishing as one possible content of the arranged affair.
Estimating and measuring supply the design parameters of the constructed system.
Joining parts into a building supplies compositional construction.
A roof that holds a structure supplies load-bearing support.
Integrity and completion supply system-wide adjustment after construction.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies activation of latent resources.
Water supplies the material resource on which the habitat's life-supporting output depends.
Pasture and grazing supply the resource's conversion into sustained nourishment.
Fixity and rooted stability supply the system's anchoring constraint.
A useful provision for needs states the designed sequence's practical output.

structural_cues: 79:27-33 is a tightly linked perfective construction sequence whose final مَتَاعًا states beneficiary-facing purpose.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, construction, support, completion, resources, anchoring, and utility; I infer that these instantiate consequence-aware tadbir as systems design. The live alternative is that the passage is an independent creation proof rather than an expansion of the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The agents abstractly arrange an affair toward an outcome.
changed_reading.after: The agents' tadbir resembles systems design: measure, assemble, stabilize, expose resources, and deliver durable benefit to living users.

context_deltas.mechanism: Preference for the nearer life is opposed by fear of one's standing, restraint of the self from inclination, and arrival at a shelter. With tadbir defined by attention to consequences and ء م ر carrying deliberation and resolve, external administration activates an inner model of governing choice from its destination backward.

activation_trace.role: Looking to the end of an affair supplies backward reasoning from destination to present conduct.
Consultation, accepting counsel, and resolving upon it supply an internal decision process.
Choosing one thing in preference to another supplies the decision point requiring governance.
The nearer or lower world supplies the immediate option whose proximity can dominate choice.
Anticipation of a harmful outcome supplies prospective constraint on present action.
Prohibition and restraint supply the executive brake within self-governance.
The living self supplies the governed subject rather than an external material system.
The self's inclination supplies the force whose direction must be regulated.
Joining a containing refuge supplies the destination that retrospectively organizes the choice.
The endpoint reached by a thing makes the same root bind restraint to terminus.

structural_cues: 79:37-41 pairs two chosen orientations with two terminal shelters.
The root ن ه ي appears as restraining the self in 79:40 and as the event's terminus in 79:44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, nearness, anticipated harm, restraint, inclination, and refuge; I infer that self-regulation is a human-scale instance of consequence-aware tadbir. The live alternative is that this is only an ethical response to the arranged affair, not a model of it.

changed_reading.before: Tadbir is external administration performed upon an affair.
changed_reading.after: Tadbir also activates as inner governance: resolve present desire by reasoning backward from the shelter or end it produces.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning seeks the event's time, anchoring gives it a fixed mooring, its terminus belongs to the Lord, and the available role is warning rather than schedule ownership; once seen, experienced duration contracts to an evening or morning. Delegated tadbir can therefore execute toward a fixed end without possessing its clock.

activation_trace.role: Management by reference to an end permits execution toward a terminus even when its date is withheld.
Sign, appointed time, and deadline make temporal specification a live dimension of the arranged affair.
Question and request supply the demand for inaccessible schedule information.
A vessel's mooring supplies a fixed but not necessarily disclosed point of arrival.
Reminder and that which makes one remember redirect the function from dating to orientation.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty locate ultimate control of the schedule.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the event's terminal boundary.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the delegated human-facing function.
Remaining in a place supplies the duration retrospectively judged at arrival.
Evening supplies one short experiential bound for the compressed duration.
The morning interval supplies the alternate short bound for that same compression.

structural_cues: 79:42 asks for timing, 79:43 redirects the question, 79:44 assigns the terminus, and 79:45 narrows the messenger's role to warning.
79:46 closes the surah by collapsing remembered duration into one evening or morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a timing question, fixed mooring, assigned terminus, warning role, and compressed duration; I infer a distinction between delegated execution and ownership of the timetable. The live alternative is that the limit applies only to the addressed messenger and says nothing about the agents of 79:5.

changed_reading.before: Distributed administrators may appear to possess broad authority over the affair.
changed_reading.after: The administrators can carry an affair toward its fixed end while its timing and ultimate ownership remain outside their delegated scope.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This spatializes a form normally read through planning, so it is branch-distant; it remains anchored in the د ب ر back/behind image, the plural active form, and the packet's following-from-behind sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a process analogy, not as identification of the agents or a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْمُدَبِّرَاتِ can retain the root's back or rear image while still performing an action upon أَمْرًا.

activation_trace.role: The back or what lies behind supplies a rear-positioned locus for administration.
The last part and passing aftermath supply the material inherited from preceding stages.
The affair supplies what the follow-on operators receive and order.
Following in another's track supplies the handoff from leading action to rear action.
A rider carried behind another supplies the image of a consequential rear echelon.

changed_reading.before: The agents plan from a supervisory position.
changed_reading.after: The agents work from the rear of the process, governing the aftermath handed back by its leading phases.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This combines rare bow, arrow, and spear branches across roots and is therefore deliberately cross-domain; it remains anchored in both focus roots and in the opening's draw-release-race sequence. Downstream prose should call it a mechanical analogy for controlled force and avoid lexicalizing the ayah as weaponry.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The د ب ر inventory includes an arrow passing behind its target, while ء م ر includes fitting a shaft with a point.

activation_trace.role: An arrow falling beyond the target supplies the failure mode that active steering must prevent.
Fitting a shaft with a sharpened point supplies directed instrumentality to the arranged command.
Drawing a bowstring supplies stored tension before release.
Drawing deeply into the bow supplies maximal loading of that tension.
A loop that can be tied and released supplies a trigger-like transition from restraint to motion.
Racing ahead supplies the projectile-like flight that still requires target-sensitive governance.

changed_reading.before: The agents administratively execute a command.
changed_reading.after: The agents regulate a fully drawn and released force so its command reaches the intended target rather than overshooting into the aftermath.

strongest_changes: The opening grammar turns generic command execution into the control stage of an extraction-to-advance pipeline.
The return block makes tadbir a designed state reversal completed by one decisive impulse.
The construction and provision block materializes tadbir as integrated habitat design judged by stable benefit.
Pharaoh's mobilization distinguishes consequence-valid governance from theatrical sovereignty.
The close limits distributed execution by locating the affair's terminal schedule and ownership beyond the delegates.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly tests the focus's end-oriented root: motion culminates in control, return is engineered through ordered shocks, Pharaoh's أَدْبَرَ in 79:22 reverses prudent tadbir into turning away, built order yields provision, and ن ه ي links restraint to terminus.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening participles may name independent agents or actions rather than successive phases of one pipeline.
The Pharaoh and creation sections may exemplify consequences of the arranged affair without directly defining 79:5.
The relation between plural administrators and the singular ownership of the terminal schedule remains intentionally unresolved.
The rear-echelon and ballistic readings depend on contained cross-branch analogy and should not be promoted to direct lexical renderings.
